name: Twilio ConversationRelay
positioning: A developer building block from Twilio that streams call audio as text over a WebSocket (with speech-to-text and text-to-speech) so teams can connect their own LLM and logic.

pricing.model: Pay-as-you-go per minute, plus separate Twilio voice charges
pricing.headline: $0.07 per minute for ConversationRelay, with voice (carrier/number) costs billed separately.
planNotes: Conversational AI pricing page: 'Conversation Relay $0.07 / minute'; 'Voice costs are calculated separately'.
Another section says 'starting at $0.07 per minute' and custom pricing for high volume via contact sales.
Real-time transcription is included in the per-minute cost per the Conversation Intelligence integration docs.
Pay-as-you-go with no commitment is the stated default; pricing marked current as of August 2026.
The LLM is the customer's own (bring your own LLM), so model costs are outside this price.
pricing.freeTrial: New accounts get $15 in trial credits, per the pricing page FAQ.
whatIsExtra: Twilio voice: US local numbers receive at $0.0085/min plus $1.15/month; outbound US/Canada $0.0140/min
Conversation Intelligence language operators if used
BYOC trunking is $0.0040/min for either direction on Twilio's voice pricing page

strengths.claim: Transparent public per-minute price ($0.07) with pay-as-you-go and no commitment.
Bring your own LLM and optionally your own text-to-speech, keeping control of the model and logic.
Runs on Twilio's global voice network with number provisioning and porting.
Adjustable interruption sensitivity, plus Deepgram (STT) and ElevenLabs (TTS) listed as speech options in Twilio's docs.
Vendor states PCI-compliant workflows and HIPAA-eligible architectures are possible.

limitations.claim: Voice costs are billed separately from the $0.07 per-minute ConversationRelay price.
It is a developer service: the customer supplies the LLM and application logic over a WebSocket.

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: product page mentions 'HIPAA-eligible architectures' and 'PCI-compliant workflows' (eligibility, not a certification of the customer's app). No SOC 2 or GDPR statement on the pages read.

telephony.providedNumbers: Twilio sells numbers (US local $1.15/month, toll-free $2.15/month) and lists BYOC trunking at $0.0040/min; whether ConversationRelay works over BYOC trunks was not verified.

stepsToLeave: Agent logic lives in the customer's own WebSocket application (bring your own LLM per the product page), so it is portable by design; Twilio does not hold a hosted agent definition per the pages read.

bestFor: Developers who want to build a custom voice agent with their own LLM on top of Twilio's voice network.

sources.title: Programmable Voice Pricing in United States

unknowns: SOC 2 and GDPR statements on pages read
